meta.title: PATH TO GLORY
meta.subtitle: vixen — certifiable builds
meta.trunk: rodin @ f40ddb443 — 12 folds; EPOCH 2 charters cut

nodes.title: taxon: one identity vocabulary crate
nodes.desc: Kind/Schema/SchemaRef/SchemaId + blake3 structural identity in one no_std crate at the bottom of the constellation. Name reserved on crates.io.

nodes.title: molten reuse + consuming move
nodes.desc: Values are molten (mutable in place when refs==1) inside computations; the consuming-move rebind rule makes reuse actually fire. Differential oracle: VIX_FORCE_MOLTEN_COPY.

nodes.title: tail loops: self-tail-call → backward jump
nodes.desc: Self-tail-calls lower to weavy backward jumps with parallel-staged param rebinding. Loops no longer cost an INVOKE per iteration; tree recursion keeps memoization on purpose.

nodes.title: hash epoch stages 1–4: typed schemas, HandleTier
nodes.desc: Descriptors carry SchemaRefs not strings; dispatch matches Kind; readiness moved off types onto handle tiers (scheduling state OUT of content identity); per-run intern table deleted — frames carry real SchemaId bits.

nodes.title: typed collections + LE everywhere
nodes.desc: Arrays/maps/options are real declared descriptors moved in lockstep with MoltenValue; full-SchemaRef descriptor keying (caught a real Doc::Array bug on day one); Sealed placeholder retired; little-endian end-to-end.

nodes.title: blake3 identity freeze — EPOCH CLOSED
nodes.desc: sha2→blake3 everywhere on identity paths, SchemaId bytes not names, stable legacy marker, descriptor hashing complete. Bonus kills: the 7GB accumulator (now 809MB — pushes move, not copy) and the Int(-1) molten sentinel bug. Honest perf: 7.3× append reuse (the old 50× harness was invalid — pop invalidates carried hashes). A hash is now a durable cross-machine cache key.

nodes.title: RUNG 2: facet-core built (real build.rs + directives)
nodes.desc: facet-core end-to-end: autocfg host lib, real build.rs run, pure-vix directive parse (check-cfg/rerun-if), registry deps, receipted rlib+rmeta. In fold.

nodes.title: RUNG 3: FACET BUILT — the ladder is complete
nodes.desc: facet with default features: real build.rs, PROC-MACRO closure for real (facet_macros dylib as host unit → lazy externs), full receipts incl. dylib hash + sealed cc capability. Bonus: found+fixed a receipts hole (store-backed array reads missing observations). The original day-goal ladder — taxon → facet-core → facet — complete.

nodes.title: EPOCH 2: identity as a field (memory-hash)
nodes.desc: Committee-converged (2 seats, 1 adversarial round): identity slots + zero-padding law implementing now (gates 1-2); map construction = sort-first, persistent Merkle tree if the decomposed residual earns it; Wagner-resistant by design. Kills the ~66% identity-recompute trunk of the 95k× solve multiplier.

nodes.title: MOLTEN_DROP: last-use analysis
nodes.desc: Refs are currently monotone; last-use analysis lets molten values die early and reuse fire more. Next machine unlock after the epoch closes.

nodes.title: JIT anomaly: solved (stringly layer, Amdahl)
nodes.desc: 2× → 1.1× on trunk: one SipHash lookup over SchemaId keys was 30.8% of JIT time (0.7% of interp's). The epoch was the fix; remaining: identity hasher on SchemaId maps + one pop-typing regression, both queued.

nodes.title: weavy DWARF type debuginfo
nodes.desc: Descriptor → DWARF type DIEs (structs, variants incl. niches, arrays, recursive refs). The observability obligation of owning our ABI, paid.

nodes.title: rodin solver in vix: search + learning
nodes.desc: Propagation, candidate selection, chronological backtracking, no-goods with point regions, restart-with-retained-facts — a CDCL-family resolver written entirely in the build language, five days old.

nodes.title: features + full semver
nodes.desc: Weak/strong/dep: features, monotone unification, prerelease-complete semver with the semver crate as differential oracle.

nodes.title: warm-facts spec: proof-bearing learning
nodes.desc: The corpus-adjudicated shape for facts that survive across solves: premise-keyed support (absence first-class), proof digest, replay-gated install. A learned fact needs a receipt like a build does.

nodes.title: rodin fact persistence (warm starts)
nodes.desc: Cross-solve learned facts, implemented to the spec. Gated hard: no persistence without the proof-bearing shape. Three lowering choices await ratification.

nodes.title: crates.io sparse index ingestion
nodes.desc: Real registry index → rodin Index facts; real fetch/extract round trip.

nodes.title: generic manifests: allowlists dead
nodes.desc: workspace=true inheritance, workspace.package, member globs — all derived in vix against the real 145-member workspace. 760 formerly-unhandleable deps → 0 mismatches.

nodes.title: cfg: snark grammar + compiler-demanded facts
nodes.desc: cfg(...) parsed by a declarative snark grammar, carried as data on dep edges (55→0 vs oracle); evaluation is pure vix over demanded `rustc --print cfg --target` facts. Cross-compilation falls out.

nodes.title: unit() derived from the solution
nodes.desc: The audit watch-point, closed: units are a recursive memoized vix function over rodin's solve output — the graph is the demand trace, dedup is memoization. Zero new host fns.

nodes.title: scale measurement: the frontier named
nodes.desc: The number: 0/863 resolve, 0/880 units — NOT divergences: each leg works (ingestion 1,122/1,122, solve, fixture units 4/4) but the composed real-scale path never existed. Reusable harness landed; re-run after every fold.

nodes.title: compose at scale: manifests + index → solve → units
nodes.desc: Ring-8 units: 9/10 exact, 10/10 targets, ZERO vix-only edges (feature emission + ring-rooted oracle fixed; one feature-set-gap pair left). Solve: zero unexplained skew everywhere reachable; perf levers folded (ring-16 171s→81s→retest).

nodes.title: CLAIM: plans the monorepo, oracle-verified
nodes.desc: Correctness CLOSED at every reachable scale (zero unexplained skew; units 9/10 with the 10th a named oracle-scope artifact). Remaining gate: solve throughput (epoch 2's target). The claim is now compute-bound, not knowledge-bound.

nodes.title: real rustc through the exec seam
nodes.desc: rustc!/build_script!/cc! lower to one demand-spawned EXEC node kind; real and fake backends behind one seam; lib/bin/proc-macro unit shapes proven at fixture scale. (Not yet sandbox-composed — see infra.)
evidence: one Command::new in all of vix/src

nodes.title: argv enum + Path.join + Tree→String
nodes.desc: FOLDED: Arg::{Str,Path,Interpolation} lazy argv (graph edges in argv costume), Tree.text projection, --extern via unit artifact subpaths. The tier-B bottleneck, gone.

nodes.title: cargo: directives as pure vix
nodes.desc: FOLDED: pure-vix cargo:/cargo:: directive parser — cfg/env/link/rerun/DEP_ propagation, loud malformed failure, OUT_DIR as producer/subpath, rerun-if recorded-never-trusted. Rust-side parser now retirement-ready.

nodes.title: RUNG 1: vixen built taxon, no hands
nodes.desc: libtaxon.rlib exists: real manifests → rodin → derived units → real build.rs executed under DECLARED cc capability (identity-receipted: Apple clang 21.0.0) → NEON C → blake3 → taxon. Zero hand-authored graph; undeclared tooling traps loudly. Ladder next: facet-core → facet.

nodes.title: proc-macro dylibs for real
nodes.desc: FOLDED: real #[derive] dylib built as host unit by real rustc, consumer uses it via lazy extern, rustc -vV in exec identity. Cross-target case included.

nodes.title: profile flag emission
nodes.desc: FOLDED: profile ingestion + rustc flag emission, ZERO divergence on all seven fields vs unit-graph oracle incl. real per-package overrides. Bonus: fixed a second molten-reuse defeat (match-arm hoisting) caught by the memcap watchdog.

nodes.title: BUILDS facet-cc for real
nodes.desc: The full-monorepo goal. Its proof-of-concept ladder is COMPLETE (taxon, facet-core, facet all build for real with receipts); remaining distance: scale (all 146 members), driven by the tier-A composition + solve throughput.

nodes.title: native tail: pinned-container interim
nodes.desc: -sys build scripts probe the ambient system; interim policy (decided): build inside a container pinned by digest — every ambient read resolves against an immutable filesystem. Final: no pkg-config, we build curl.

nodes.title: BUILDS upstream cargo
nodes.desc: The oracle becomes the subject: unmodified rust-lang/cargo at a pinned commit, built by vixen with receipts. The external flagship; the sovereignty demo in one sentence.

nodes.title: sandbox stage 1: confine
nodes.desc: Seatbelt confinement: undeclared reads fail loudly. Public protocol types over vox RPC, private impls. FOLDED to vixen main.

nodes.title: memcap watchdog: no more machine OOMs
nodes.desc: Every nextest test runs under an RSS-sampling wrapper — SIGKILL past MEMCAP_MB (6GB default). Born from a test allocating 22GB in 4s; caught its first runaway in production within the hour (7GB accumulator → loud single-test fail). Also a memory tripwire for every future gate.

nodes.title: sandbox stage 2: observe (VFS)
nodes.desc: vfsd observations (File/Directory/LookupMiss, blake3 newtypes) populate ExecOutcome read-sets; progressive ExecTree events with close-is-provisional verification; kill hook typed but dormant. vfsd close-callback integration precisely pinned. FOLDED to vixen main.

nodes.title: HERMETIC: vix ∘ RPC ∘ sandbox + FSKit VFS
nodes.desc: Summit reached: vix/RPC/seatbelt composition is folded; the FSKit runner path now uses singleton vx-vfsd virtual prefixes and tracked_observations(prefix_id, roots) as the ExecReadSet authority. Live /Volumes/Vixen/vfs proof passed on VixenFS 0.6.3 with no copy staging: real spawned process read through /Volumes/Vixen/vfs/vx/<prefix> and produced File + LookupMiss observations.
evidence: live proof: VixenFS 0.6.3, nextest run 15b6b54a-c159-40c5-bb4e-df1500a85bec, 1 passed

nodes.title: Stage A: overlap the exec waits
nodes.desc: Scheduler audit verdict: the driver IS a work-queue scheduler (design's staged rung 1, workers deferred by plan) — but exec drains inline-synchronously, serializing subprocess waits. Stage A: spawn-and-park via existing waiter machinery. I/O overlap, CPU stays serial.

nodes.title: progressive trees: pipelining ≡ check ≡ kill
nodes.desc: Exec output trees materialize incrementally; subfile demands park on close events. Pipelining, vx check, and kill-when-satisfied become one mechanism. Protocol events already landed in stage 2.

nodes.title: rmeta subfile cutoff (RDR decision half)
nodes.desc: Consumers referencing only the .rmeta inside a unit's output tree get rmeta-level early cutoff from the argv grammar itself — per-subfile invalidation granularity.

nodes.title: reloc-walk test selection
nodes.desc: FOLDED: reloc-walk capability on trunk — Reached/NotReached/UnknownRun, panic-Location masking, skipped-tests-run-as-audit-oracle.

nodes.title: knowledge base: user + dev + vix sites
nodes.desc: Three mounts: user site (pain-led), /dev (machine internals), /vix (the language reference — 14 pages, real-program examples, dated gaps appendix, migrated from /dev, render-verified live).

nodes.title: sovereignty lane: /provenance/
nodes.desc: "You now have to prove what's in your software — as law." CRA/NIS2/DORA mapped to mechanisms; real-today vs designed-spec always marked.

nodes.title: registry design: rebuild / upgrade / audit
nodes.desc: Recipe-embedded artifacts (the binary is its own flake), vx upgrade re-resolves from the embedded request, advisories keyed by content hash (backport-aware), overlays as resolver feature, transparency log, EU infra, 2FA.

nodes.title: EU registry: design → build
nodes.desc: The first inhabitant of the cloud control plane. Open question #1 gates the rest: what is a package (source / artifacts+attestations / both).

nodes.title: naming resolved: vixen, certifiable builds
nodes.desc: The mark stays vixen (joy is load-bearing); tagline 'certifiable builds'; cachet = the sealed receipt object. Blind committees validated the territory (6/6 French/Latin authenticity instruments) without finding the word.
evidence: "maybe it's called fucking MetalGraph or whatever"

nodes.title: EU SOVEREIGNTY LAUNCH — the money
nodes.desc: Traceability, auditability, EU operation — real on day one, structural not certificational. CRA reporting obligations bite Sep 2026; France alone assembled ~€13B. The thing that funds everything else.
